sources.entry: RomM ⚠ - ROM manager for organizing, enriching, and playing retro games, with support for 400+ platforms. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker
RomM | ROM manager with metadata, artwork and an in-browser emulator

summary.one_liner: RomM is a self-hosted ROM manager that scans, enriches, and browses a retro game collection and lets you play it in the browser.
summary.what_it_does: Scans a ROM library and enriches it with metadata and artwork from providers including IGDB, Screenscraper, LaunchBox, MobyGames, and SteamGridDB, plus achievements from RetroAchievements. Plays games in the browser through EmulatorJS and RuffleRS. Syncs saves and states across devices with conflict resolution. Supports 400+ platforms, including multi-disk games, DLCs, mods, hacks, and manuals. Includes a built-in ROM patcher for applying romhacks and translations. Offers per-user permissions and OIDC single sign-on for sharing a library. Official companion apps exist for Playnite, Android (Argosy), and custom firmware handhelds (Grout).
use_cases: fetch game metadata and box art
share a game library with family or friends
patch romhacks and translations onto ROMs
how_to_run: Follow the Quick Start Guide in the project docs (linked from the README; the link target is not included in the text provided)
notable: In-browser emulation via EmulatorJS and RuffleRS with no setup required
Save and state sync across devices with conflict resolution
Official client apps for Playnite, Android, and handheld custom firmwares
Built-in ROM patcher for romhacks and translations
caveats: Some listings mark it with a warning symbol; the README does not explain it
Hosted deployment is offered through a paid third-party provider (Hostinger) starting at $6.49/mo
Community apps are maintained by members and not reviewed by the core team
